name: com.viitorx.avtar.tracking
description: Camera tracking for Unity from one compiled engine: hands, face, a cut-out person and a whole body that drives a VRM avatar. This package has no code of its own: it names the five packages of the family (core, sidecar, vision, cutout, body) at one version, so installing it from a registry installs them all. UniVRM (needed by the body package) and the engine itself are installed separately; see the README.
